t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
From among the jinn and mankind."

f.2016: i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.
f.2017: Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.
